description: Africa's Infrastructure National Data is the country-level database of the Africa Infrastructure Country Diagnostic (AICD), a knowledge programme on the state of network infrastructure in Africa. It gives cross-country indicators for nine sectors, air transport, information and communication technologies, irrigation, ports, power, railways, roads, and water and sanitation, covering affordability, access, pricing and institutional, fiscal and financial aspects, for 1990 to 2009. It is published by the World Bank in its data catalogue with sister datasets for ports, electricity and railways. The data are available free through the World Bank DataBank under the CC BY 4.0 licence; a mirror on the KAPSARC data portal holds about 47,700 records. Caveats: the series end around 2009 and many indicators are sparse, and the original AICD website domain now hosts unrelated content. It offers a historical multi-sector baseline of infrastructure access and spending in African countries for investment and planning studies; a related record is the Global Infrastructure Hub Infrastructure Monitor.
